title: SUMMARIZE can group by a column added in the query

source.quote: -- SUMMARIZE has the option of grouping by columns computed -- in the query.
source.supports: the page shows this query shape with one row per SalesType and its amount

source.quote: SUMMARIZE uses the filter on all the columns in the cluster that produced a given value
source.supports: the amount of a group is computed over the Sales rows in its cluster

derivation: Quantity per Sales row: 1, 2, 1, 5, 2, 3, 1. Large (quantity above 1): rows 2, 4, 5, 6 = 40 + 50 + 200 + 30 = 320. Small: rows 1, 3, 7 = 100 + 20 + 100 = 220. Total 540.
